1.web: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it, or sells it; he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
1.asv: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

2.web: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.
2.asv: If the thief be found breaking in, and be smitten so that he dieth, there shall be no bloodguiltiness for him.

3.web: If the sun has risen on him, guilt of bloodshed shall be for him; he shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
3.asv: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be bloodguiltiness for him; he shall make restitution: if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

4.web: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.
4.asv: If the theft be found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep, he shall pay double.

5.web: “If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten, and lets his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.
5.asv: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall let his beast loose, and it feed in another man’s field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.

6.web: “If fire breaks out, and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
6.asv: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

7.web: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief is found, he shall pay double.
7.asv: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief be found, he shall pay double.

8.web: If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to God, to find out if he hasn’t put his hand to his neighbor’s goods.
8.asv: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall come near unto God, to see whether he have not put his hand unto his neighbor’s goods.

9.web: For every matter of trespass, whether it be for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before God. He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.
9.asv: For every matter of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, whereof one saith, This is it, the cause of both parties shall come before God; he whom God shall condemn shall pay double unto his neighbor.

10.web: “If a man delivers to his neighbor a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies or is injured, or driven away, no man seeing it;
10.asv: If a man deliver unto his neighbor an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:

11.web: the oath of Yahweh shall be between them both, whether he hasn’t put his hand to his neighbor’s goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.
11.asv: the oath of Jehovah shall be between them both, whether he hath not put his hand unto his neighbor’s goods; and the owner thereof shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.

12.web: But if it is stolen from him, he shall make restitution to its owner.
12.asv: But if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.

13.web: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.
13.asv: If it be torn in pieces, let him bring it for witness: he shall not make good that which was torn.

14.web: “If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.
14.asv: And if a man borrow aught of his neighbor, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.

15.web: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.
15.asv: If the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be a hired thing, it came for its hire.

16.web: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.
16.asv: And if a man entice a virgin that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.

17.web: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
17.asv: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

18.web: “You shall not allow a sorceress to live.
18.asv: Thou shalt not suffer a sorceress to live.

19.web: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.
19.asv: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.

20.web: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to Yahweh only, shall be utterly destroyed.
20.asv: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto Jehovah only, shall be utterly destroyed.

21.web: “You shall not wrong an alien, neither shall you oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
21.asv: And a sojourner shalt thou not wrong, neither shalt thou oppress him: for ye were sojourners in the land of Egypt.

22.web: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.
22.asv: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.

23.web: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;
23.asv: If thou afflict them at all, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;

24.web: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
24.asv: and my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

25.web: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor; neither shall you charge him interest.
25.asv: If thou lend money to any of my people with thee that is poor, thou shalt not be to him as a creditor; neither shall ye lay upon him interest.

26.web: If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,
26.asv: If thou at all take thy neighbor’s garment to pledge, thou shalt restore it unto him before the sun goeth down:

27.web: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious.
27.asv: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.

28.web: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.
28.asv: Thou shalt not revile God, nor curse a ruler of thy people.

29.web: “You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. “You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me.
29.asv: Thou shalt not delay to offer of thy harvest, and of the outflow of thy presses. The first-born of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.

30.web: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. Seven days it shall be with its mother, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me.
30.asv: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with its dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.

31.web: “You shall be holy men to me, therefore you shall not eat any flesh that is torn by animals in the field. You shall cast it to the dogs.
31.asv: And ye shall be holy men unto me: therefore ye shall not eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.
